uncertainties.note: Scene identification: rows 3230-3309 (resource 6100, table_offset 1456, text ids 101-233) are Mission 10A, 'Defend Amaterasu': a target-elimination combat mission that is interrupted when a black machine and the Martian Successors surface from inside the Amaterasu facility. Rows 3215-3229 (resource 6093, a different mission's end) and context rows after 3309 belong to other scenes/agents and were read for context only, not translated here.

The source text itself is fullwidth Latin letters, not Japanese: 'OTIKA...', then '!' plus six fullwidth spaces, then 'AKI, TO...'. This reads as a deliberately garbled/interference radio transmission building up to the row 3278 recognition ('Akito-san...!?'); kept verbatim (fullwidth converted to plain ASCII) rather than 'corrected' to spell AKITO, since the scrambling looks intentional (dramatic reveal), not a typo.

Archaic/poetic proclamation by the Martian Successors' broadcast, apparently unique to this game (not located in any consulted wiki). '天津国' (Amatsukuni, a classical Shinto term for the heavenly realm) is rendered 'the heavens'; the pun on 'ヒサゴ' (Hisago/gourd, the plan's namesake) is kept literal ('like a gourd'). Meaning and register are uncertain; flagging for a second look rather than guessing a more idiomatic English proverb.

Confirms the Ruins/Boson Jump/Hisago Plan connection ahead of the fuller explanation at rows 3354-3358; 'Boson Jump' has no book() tag on these particular rows in the source (unlike row 3355), so it was left as plain text there per the tag-fidelity rule.

Speakers are untagged. 3291 ('Ruri... are you watching?') is consistent with Akito addressing Ruri Hoshino through a monitor; 3305-3306 and 3309 read as a bystander (contextually Ryoko, given 3293-3295 address her by name) reacting to seeing Yurika and Akito on screen. No speaker identity was written into any target; this is inference for the report only.
